api/ASE_Assignment.html.keywords: Namespace ASE_Assignment Classes AppArray Represents a one- or two-dimensional array variable within the BOOSE execution environment. AppBoolean Represents a boolean variable in the BOOSE language. Handles declaration, assignment, and evaluation of boolean expressions. AppCall Represents a call command that invokes a user-defined method with parameters within the BOOSE program execution environment. AppCanvas Represents a drawable canvas that supports shapes, lines, text, and color operations. Provides methods required by the BOOSE BOOSE.ICanvas interface. AppCircle Represents the command that draws a circle on the canvas. AppCommandFactory Factory class responsible for creating application-specific command instances. AppDrawTo Represents a drawing command that draws a line from the current position of the pen to the specified (x, y) coordinates. AppElse Represents an else clause in a conditional control structure. AppEnd Represents an end command that terminates compound control structures such as conditionals, loops, and method declarations. AppFor Represents a for loop command that iterates over a numeric range. AppIf Represents an if conditional command that controls the execution of a block of statements based on a boolean condition. AppInt Represents an integer variable in the BOOSE language. Handles declaration, assignment, and evaluation of integer expressions. AppMethod Represents a user-defined method declaration within the BOOSE program model. AppMoveTo Represents a command that moves the pen to the specified (x, y) coordinates without drawing a line. AppParser Parser class for analyzing and converting BOOSE program text into executable commands. Handles variable declarations, control structures (if, while, for), arrays, methods, and drawing commands. Implements the IParser interface from the BOOSE library. Bypasses BOOSE library restrictions by resetting static counters. AppPeek Represents a peek command that reads a value from an array into a variable. Syntax: variable = arrayName row [column] AppPen Represents a command that changes the pen colour used for drawing on the canvas. AppPoke Represents a poke command that writes a value to an array element. Syntax: arrayName row [column] = value AppReal Represents a real (floating-point) variable and expression evaluation within the BOOSE execution environment. AppRectangle Represents a command that draws a rectangle on the canvas. Supports both filled and unfilled rectangles based on parameters. AppStoredProgram Represents a stored program with conditional command stack functionality. Inherits from the BOOSE.StoredProgram class and provides custom implementations for managing commands. AppWhile Represents a while loop command that repeatedly executes a block of statements while a condition evaluates to true. AppWrite Represents a write command that outputs text or evaluated expressions to the program's drawing canvas.
